title: Add word-level fast path to BitVec::polar_transform_into for stride>=64
description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: bitwise-arithmetic** (report finding #3)

`BitVec::polar_transform_into` (`crates/gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs:1532`) iterates bit-by-bit for all stride values. For stride >= 64 the Arikan butterfly reduces to a word-level XOR, so the bit loop is ~64x slower than necessary on large inputs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A fast path XOR-assigns word slices when stride >= 64 and both butterfly segments are word-aligned, via `kernels::ops::xor_inplace` (or equivalent existing core helper); the bit-by-bit loop is retained only for stride < 64.
- [hard] Output is bit-identical to the previous implementation across word-boundary sizes (existing polar-transform tests still pass; add a test comparing fast-path vs scalar reference for n spanning multiple words).
- [aspirational] Benchmark shows a measurable speedup for large inputs (record the observed factor in the issue per the measurements-not-guesses rule).
- [hard] Full `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy, fmt pass.
